names.en: Jiangsu Panda Power Technology Co., Ltd.

strengths.text: Theo hãng: tổ máy diesel từ 1 kVA đến 3750 kVA, động cơ Cummins, Volvo, Perkins, Deutz, MTU, Shanghai (SDEC), FAW, Weichai; đầu phát Stamford, Marathon, Leroy Somer, Engga
Có các dạng máy trần, giảm âm, container, rơ-moóc (trailer)

missing: Chưa tìm thấy chứng chỉ ISO/CE trên trang đã đọc
Không ghi prime/standby cho dải chung

quote: Jiangsu Panda Power Technology Co., Ltd. established in 1993, we are one of the largest diesel generator set manufacturers in Chinese Mainland. We are specialized in producing 1KVA to 3750kVA diesel generator sets with Cummins, Volvo, PERKINS, DEUTZ, MTU, Shanghai, FAW, Weichai and other engines, equipped with STAMFORD, MARATHON, LEROY SOMER, ENGGA alternators.
Address: No.9 Fuxi Road, Hanjiang District, Jiangsu Province , China
